## About
Boruske Brothers was started in Bellevue by the Boruske brothers, Virgil, Vic and Steve, and later moved to Dayton. Greg Smith worked with the brothers as their paint representative before he and his family bought the shop. We're still family owned, and Virgil still visits often.
When you come in, you might meet Deb at the front, Doug estimating your repair, or Jim and Tony back in production and paint. We'll help with your insurance claim, set you up with a rental, keep you posted on the work, and clean your car inside and out before you pick it up.
You'll find us on Ervin Terrace, just east of the Big Mac Bridge and Newport, near Fort Thomas, Bellevue, Covington and Southgate.

## Services
- Full Service Collision Repair: From the first estimate to the final inspection, we handle the whole repair on all makes and models.
- Precision Frame/Unibody Repairs: We check the inner structure and use our computerized measuring system to get your vehicle back to factory specifications.
- Automotive Refinishing: We verify your paint code with the Spies Hecker color computer and camera for a proper color match.
- Door Dings & Small Dent Repair: Dings and dents taken care of, large or small.
- Wheel Repair & Replacement: Damaged wheels repaired or replaced.
- Auto Glass & Windshield Repair: Glass and windshield repair as part of your fix or on its own.
- Headlight Restoration: Cloudy headlights brought back.
- Pickup, Delivery & Towing: We can pick up your car, and you too.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Estimate appointments are there for your convenience, but you're welcome to just stop in.

Q: Do you work with my insurance?
A: Yes. We accept all car insurance plans, and we can help whether you're paying out of pocket or going through your insurer.

Q: Can I come in early, late or on a Saturday?
A: Yes, by appointment. Give us a call and we'll set up a time that works.

Q: Do you work on aluminum cars like a Tesla?
A: We're not Tesla certified, but we do work on aluminum cars. One reviewer brought us his Tesla Model S and we were upfront about what we could and couldn't do.

Q: Do you repair my make and model?
A: Yes. Our technicians and staff repair all vehicle makes and models.
